status: learned from ONE reference; every number is measured unless marked inferred
render_note: Reference is 720x1280 @24 fps. Zeno renders 1080x1920 @30; scale all pixel values by 1.5.
visuals: fully AI-generated: live-action cafe scene, a 3D-cartoon teacher (Miss Nova), a woman in pyjamas at night

structure.name: restaurant (English)
structure.shots: wide establishing, then one close-up per speaker, then a reaction close-up of the friend

structure.name: after lunch (Malayalam)
structure.cutting: ONE continuous two-shot, no cuts, no zoom

structure.name: night, AI teacher (Malayalam + English words)
structure.cutting: no full-frame cuts; each panel swaps clip at turn boundaries

script_cues: 'SPLIT SCREEN' with 'Woman - Right screen' / 'Miss Nova - Left screen'
stage directions in (parentheses) and plain sentences (laughter, queue)

scene1_shot_grammar.cut_lead_sec: speech starts 0.12-0.22 s after the cut to that speaker (L3, L4, L5; L1 is the first shot); L2 has a 1.05 s reaction beat first
scene1_shot_grammar.cut_tail_sec: the cut to the next speaker lands 0.03-0.21 s after the previous line ends (L1-L3)
scene1_shot_grammar.after_last_line: the laughter plays over the same close-up for ~4 s, then a 1.7 s reaction shot, then the transition

framing.face_center_y_frac: 0.32-0.37 in every close-up and in both split panels

split_h.divider: thin light line, about 3 px of 720, colour ~#E1DBE1, no border highlight, no dimming of the listener
split_h.panel_swaps: 7 hard clip swaps inside panels at turn boundaries (44.21, 47.96, 50.96, 58.92, 65.46, 73.96, 84.38); each is small (the character goes from talking to listening pose); the full frame never cuts

zoom.note: face width stays within 4% inside shots 2, 3, 7 and 8; shots 4-6 changed 4-13%, most likely subject motion inside the AI clip (not confirmed with a background-scale test). Variety comes from shot size, not zoom.

transition_between_scenes.name: warm_flash
transition_between_scenes.envelope_frames: 9 flash frames, screen-blended colours in assets/transitions/warm_flash.json: yellow (255,199,60) for frames 1-3, shifting to red (238,66,54) by frame 5, then dark red (139,19,27) fading out
transition_between_scenes.content_swap: frame 6 after the flash starts for scene 1 to 2, frame 4 for scene 2 to 3 (the swap is hidden under the flash)
transition_between_scenes.audio: no whoosh; scene-boundary audio dips to near silence (0.05-0.2 s)
transition_between_scenes.implementation: BUILT: assets/transitions/warm_flash.json (screen-blend colours per frame), applied by scripts/render.py as lutrgb filters over a hard cut. Uniform colour per frame, so the reference's slight colour gradient across the frame is not reproduced.

timing.scene_boundary: transition starts as the last line of the scene ends (+/-0.05 s); next scene's first line starts 0.1-0.5 s after the transition ends
timing.measured_with: wav2vec2 base 95M with energy start snap and end extension

audio.note: normalise to Zeno's -14 LUFS; the reference is quieter

on_screen_text.non_subtitle: none found (no title cards, buttons or logos; 'Install Now' appears only inside the subtitle)
on_screen_text.subtitles: present (word-by-word, white text, blue highlight on the current word, lower-middle). IGNORED by instruction; not measured or reproduced

unknowns: format of the future raw footage (per-line clips? per-scene clips?)
whether the listener in split screen is a separate idle clip
how Zeno should choose a reaction shot (scene 1 shot 6) from raw clips

engine.note: read by scripts/style_plan.py; everything else in this file is for people and the Director

rebuild_check.method: stand-in clips cut from the reference (input/standins/, not committed), rebuilt with style_plan.py + render.py at 720x1280@24, compared frame by frame (mean absolute pixel difference, 0-255, at 180x320)
rebuild_check.flash_frames_mean_diff: 10-18 (a flash wash baked into the reference's subtitle pill and a colour gradient are not reproduced)
rebuild_check.caveat: stand-ins come from the reference itself, so this proves the render side only; it does not test take selection or clip-to-line matching on real raw footage
